mapper.sql: e.EMP_NO, e.EMP_NM, e.DEPT_CD, e.POS_CD, e.HIRE_DT, e.EMAIL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMP WHERE DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND RETIRE_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HR_EMP (EMP_NO, EMP_NM, DEPT_CD, POS_CD, HIRE_DT, EMAIL, REG_DT) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{empNm}, #{deptCd}, #{posCd}, #{hireDt}, #{email}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE HR_EMP e SET e.RETIRE_YN = 'Y' WHERE e.EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_APPNT a WHERE a.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO AND a.STATUS_CD = '10')
